neighbours.label: a kind-sorting adjective that says what class a thing belongs to, usually in a list: scent families (woody, musky, smoky), disease forms (cutaneous, ocular), levels of analysis (genetic and functional). Adjectives of size, strength or plain quality in the same lists stay quiet
fire: The perfume dries down to a mossy, smoky and leathery base.
The cologne blends citrus with musky and woody undertones.
The infection has three forms: pulmonary, cutaneous and ocular.
The lymphoma appears in nodal, cutaneous and visceral forms.
Mutations there have cellular and functional consequences for the kinase.
The team mapped the genetic and functional ties between the two genes.
The tea has an earthy, smoky flavour with a sweet finish.
We found molecular and functional changes in the receptor.
quiet: The perfume dries down to a warm, soft and gentle base.
The cologne blends citrus with light and clean undertones.
The infection has three stages: early, middle and late.
The lymphoma appears in mild, severe and rare forms.
Mutations there have large and lasting consequences for the kinase.
The team mapped the close and distant ties between the two genes.
The tea has a mild, sweet flavour with a long finish.
We found big and small changes in the receptor.
